title.narrative: Phase-out of methyl bromide used as a soil fumigant in the production of green beans and cucurbits

description.narrative: The aim of the project is to phase out 106.2 ODP tonnes of methyl bromide (MB), which is presently used by 172 growers to fumigate 200 ha of green beans (3 cycles per season) and about 100 ha of cucurbits. MB is used for controlling nematodes, MNSV (melon necrotic spot virus) and fungi. In view of this, grafting has been selected as the most appropriate alternative technology for melons. Alternatives chosen for green beans are as follows: (1) bio-fumigation plus solarization for the first cycle (2) soil less substrates for the second cycle and (3) chemicals for the third cycle. These technologies have been tested by the growers in Morocco and are in wide use both in Article (2) and Article (5) countries. By implementing this project, the Kingdom of Morocco will achieve complete phase out of MB by 2012.
